title: Marlowe Rewards Tiers and the Wrong-Shipment Refund Basis on Wrong Item Claims
content:
Loyalty partnership note for Delivery Claims: on a Wrong Item Claim, the wrong-shipment refund basis follows how the order's delivery fee was reached and, where a free-shipping credit reduced it, the customer's active Marlowe Rewards tier.

**Rule.** The wrong-shipment refund basis depends on how the fee was reached: where the order's effective shipping fee is above 0.00 and equals the list fee of its delivery service less that service's free-shipping credit (a free-shipping credit was taken off and nothing else), and the customer's active Marlowe Rewards tier is Platinum, Icon or Atelier, the wrong-shipment refund basis is the list fee of the delivery service plus the surcharge; where the fee was reduced in that way and the active tier is Silver or Gold, it is the fee paid plus half of the credit taken off plus the surcharge; in every other case it is the fee paid plus the surcharge.

- Effective shipping fee and surcharge: as shown on the order. List fee and free-shipping credit: those of the order's delivery service in the Online Orders service schedule. Half of the credit taken off is half the difference between the list fee and the fee paid.
- Active tier: the tier of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active — Marlowe Rewards Platinum, Icon or Atelier; Marlowe Rewards Silver or Gold.

| Fee paid above 0.00 and equal to list fee less the service's free-shipping credit | Active Marlowe Rewards tier | Wrong-shipment refund basis |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Platinum, Icon or Atelier | list fee plus surcharge |
| yes | Silver or Gold | fee paid plus half the credit taken off plus surcharge |
| yes | Member, or no active membership | fee paid plus surcharge |
| no | any | fee paid plus surcharge |

## Worked figures (hypothetical service: list fee 18.00 USD, free-shipping credit 5.00 USD; surcharge 0.00 USD)

- Fee paid 13.00 USD, active tier Atelier: 18.00 USD.
- Fee paid 13.00 USD, active tier Gold: 13.00 plus 2.50, that is 15.50 USD.
- Fee paid 13.00 USD, no active membership: 13.00 USD.
- Fee paid 0.00 USD, active tier Platinum: the fee is not above 0.00, so 0.00 plus the surcharge, 0.00 USD.
